episodes.title: The last ferryman on the lake
episodes.description: Arvid Holm has rowed passengers across for forty years. He talks weather, old engines and the night the ice came early.

episodes.title: Mending nets with three generations
episodes.description: A grandmother, her son and his daughter repair the same nets on the same quay, and argue about knots.

episodes.title: Fish market at four in the morning
episodes.description: Auctioneers, ice and a lot of shouting. We follow one crate of mackerel from boat to breakfast.
